chronology.P7B: target-free CAL confidence/threshold/decision freeze; no CAL outcomes
chronology.P7C: one-time CAL outcome opening and adjudication

confidence.g1: lowest mu_g; tie lower SG index
confidence.g2: second-lowest mu_g; tie lower SG index
confidence.mu_g: RF ensemble mean prediction for group g
confidence.name: RF_STANDARDIZED_TOP2_GAP
confidence.raw_top2_gap: diagnostic only, never an alternative policy
confidence.sd_g: sample SD (ddof=1) of 500 tree predictions for group g
confidence.single_selectable_group: bypass confidence and use sole group

fallback.choice: first ranked group in parent's final selectable action set
fallback.name: GLOBAL_RANK_V3_13G_FULL_TRAIN
fallback.statistic: action-row-weighted mean eligible regret by group

forbidden_after_cal_outcomes: choose a sensitivity point because it looks better
drop abstained parents from deployment metrics

adopt_if: at least one of mean_regret or CVaR90 improves by >1e-12
every actionable CAL parent receives selector, fallback, or explicit technical-refusal status
p7c_cal_gate.cal_opening: one-time only after P7B scores, thresholds, selector choices and fallback choices are hashed
p7c_cal_gate.control: full-coverage RF_D8_L001 on identical actionable CAL parents
p7c_cal_gate.if_fail: confidence NOT_ADOPTED; canonical selector remains full-coverage RF_D8_L001
p7c_cal_gate.other_coverage_points: report-only sensitivities; cannot replace the frozen 90% primary point

selector_refit.choice: minimum raw predicted log1p(regret), tie lower SG index
selector_refit.fit_data: all actionable V2_TRAIN label rows only
selector_refit.preprocess: per-group TRAIN finite unweighted median; all-invalid=0; no scaling; no winsorization

threshold_freeze_p7b.accept_rule: selector if score >= threshold else fallback
threshold_freeze_p7b.data: actionable V2_CAL confidence scores only; CAL target values forbidden
